name: tracker-notification-delivery
goal: Prove legacy callback identity, durable webhook retry, send-time eligibility, grouped quiet-hour delivery and reminder transitions using synthetic destinations.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Pinned Tracker 122e190 notifier.js, deliver.js and webhook.js. Prove event keys and delivery envelopes, local callbacks, hub outbox, backoff, stale-event drops, quiet-hour batches and durable replay on synthetic actors.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: New delivery service declares method states for scanning, send, retry, pause and restart; the timing helpers do not cover its injected storage and destination boundary.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed 466ff13d93 with all scenario registrations and the matcher recorder. Delivery cases fail on the scaffold with the expected missing delivery assertion.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Ported completion callbacks, webhook outbox, flag and due reminders and Chief of Staff batches. Queue transactions preserve issued requests and receipts.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
